name: gradient-magic-ray
title: Magic Ray
description: A static multi-stop gradient laid on a shallow diagonal: strong hot pink on the left, a dark purple waist, and blue on the right, all inside a wide rounded panel.
use: A rich pink-purple-blue field should add drama behind a title or feature panel.
avoid: The saturated stops are fixed in the source and clash with a light or neutral palette.
a11y: Decorative gradient only, so there are no controls or labels to provide. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle on a black stage. Hot pink occupies the left side, deepening into a moody violet across the middle before easing into medium blue at the right edge, with a faint diagonal grain in the blend.
behaves: Static: nothing changes; the same pink-to-blue sweep repeats in each frame.
customise: className and style resize it or replace the paint; the pink, purple and blue stops and the angle are in the source.
weight: light: One div painted with a CSS gradient; no scripts or animation.
